coverage_assessment: Thirteen registered Dutch/English open-web searches with 420 ordered headers and 34 source cards (9 opened, 24 search-only, 1 URL-specific HTTP 429) support 7 candidate leads, 2 exclusions and 13 gaps. The 24 body attempts yielded 9 article reads and 15 no-body technical outcomes. Searches focused on COVID/curfew, Schiphol and Lenterebellie; they do not reproduce LexisNexis or establish exhaustive Dutch coverage. Regional and sector coverage and several candidate thresholds, demands and endpoints remain unresolved.
